title: The Venom of the Tarantula
subtitle: A Mastermind Faces a Deadly New Puzzle
summary: When relentless detective Byomkesh Bakshi is pried away from a tangled forgery case for a rare stroll, neither he nor his companion can imagine the dark twists fate has in store. As the calm of the evening gives way to shadows, a venomous mystery begins to stir, testing Byomkesh’s legendary intellect. Step into a world where danger lurks beneath the surface and every clue could be deadly.
